checks.finding: Hidden and visible Q use the identical eight features, formulas, weights, normalization, validity rules, and missingness handling; the pairwise score is antisymmetric around 0.5.
All registered features are causal; LK and motion evidence use only current or past state, and skipped-frame dependencies are explicit.
Appearance, motion, geometry, and confidence missingness are explicit; missing optional evidence is neutral with an unavailable mask, while invalid mandatory evidence abstains.
Monotonic directions are coherent: stronger hidden evidence cannot reduce preference, stronger visible evidence reduces it, and staleness cannot improve it.
The quantity is consistently named owner_preference_score and is explicitly uncalibrated and not a probability.

Development and validation are disjoint by video and session: development uses 2019-11-29 videos 000233 and 000263; validation uses 2019-11-28 and 2019-11-30 videos 000085, 000114, 000327, and 000328.
A distinct blinded process assigned validation roles from source video, locked GT, RF_ACC23 evidence, rationale, and pre-H1-r2 metadata, without viewing H1-r2 outputs.
All six H1-r1 episodes are development or audit rows with validation_eligible=false and reason used_for_h1_r1_design_and_cost_audit.
The 0.60 threshold was frozen without validation data or tracking metrics; screening used predeclared hand-calculated golden development cases and domain rationale.
The evaluation contract forbids threshold or weight changes after the single validation view, and the gate and validation boundaries are hash-bound.
Promotion remains unauthorized throughout the design, activation, evaluation, and review artifacts.
Runtime evaluation remains a later independent gate with explicit overhead, repeat-FPS, memory, and common-harness requirements.

threshold_freeze.finding: Real symmetric H1-r2 feature rows cannot exist before implementation without violating the task boundary. Freezing 0.60 as a theory-driven prior from independently calculated golden cases is defensible because it was not selected from tracking or validation outcomes. It establishes no real activation, control specificity, tracking quality, or evaluation readiness.

minimum_hidden_overlap.finding: The hidden-only overlap >= 0.50 condition is a directional owner-claim abstention gate, not an asymmetric score feature. It requires direct geometry before overriding a visible assignment and can only suppress action; hidden and visible Q definitions remain symmetric.

residual_limitations: No real H1-r2 development activation, control specificity, or tracking-quality evidence exists before implementation; those remain evaluation gates.
Golden-case screening validates mathematical operating intent, not empirical episode behavior.
Role-assignment blindness is a distinct-process attestation with hash-bound evidence, not an independently captured access log.
The 0.60 threshold and companion gates must remain frozen through validation; any later change creates a new hypothesis revision.
Final authorization must bind and pass the completed checker package.
